text.tspan: surge. Load / unload in the order

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
text.tspan: Surge: liquid keeps moving when you start, stop, or turn. A partially filled tank is often the worst case.
Drive smoothly -- start, stop, and change lanes gradually. Increase following distance. Be extra careful on curves, ramps, and downhill grades.
Outage (leave room for expansion) is a loading rule, especially in heat. Overfilled tanks can overflow or build pressure.
Baffles help only along the tank's length. They do not make a tank safe to drive like a dry van.
